Для экспериментального нахождения мод ко: To experimentally determine the oscillation modes, it is convenient to use the phenomenon of resonance. To study resonance, it is necessary to be able to create a periodic disturbance with a variable frequency. To implement this idea, a simple mathematical pendulum with a massive bob is used. Both pendulums are suspended on the same horizontal string. The swinging massive pendulum (whose length can be changed) causes the horizontal string, to which both pendulums are attached, to oscillate. The oscillations of this string create a driving force for the light double pendulum. It can be assumed that the oscillations of this light pendulum practically do not affect the oscillations of the massive pendulum.

However, for certain relationships between the deviation angles, the pendulum oscillations are stable and maintain their shape. Such oscillations are called normal modes (also known as modes of oscillation). Finding the types of natural oscillations and their frequencies is a rather complex mathematical problem.
